text_block_list.text:
On a certain day off.
While relaxing in my room and having breakfast...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
DING-DONG DING-DOOOONG!!!
Trainer-san, pleeease open up--!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so much for everything, always!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I met Trainer,
this and that and...
anyway, they've taught me so many things!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my fortune-telling is spot-on and on a roll!
My running's improving by leaps and bounds, reaching its absolute peak!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Forget just grabbing the Goddess of Victory by the back of her hair,
I feel like I could grab it and braid it!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Trainer and Lady Shiraoki!
Bless you! Blessings upon you~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well then! Now that I've conveyed my true feelings just as the dream prophesied...
I shall take my leave!!

I didn't quite get the logic...
but she seems satisfied with the training advice...!
